geometry_extraction.opencv_pin_reason: floorplan-synth locks OpenCV 4.13; its Hough line code fails on OpenCV 5
geometry_extraction.vectorizer_confidence_note: The vectorizer writes confidence=1.0 for every wall. It is a hard-coded default, not a model score, and is not used.

notes: Checkpoint hash: computed from the checkpoint file during candidate preparation.
Bit layout verified against the upstream masks/README.md and the writer _save_prediction_masks in mitunet_cubicasa/hierarchical_evaluation.py.
No annotation SVG and no ground-truth mask was read to construct this geometry.
The upstream structural_wall head predicts walls with openings NOT subtracted, so a wall runs through its doors; the door_opening head proposes the aperture.

transforms.y_axis: candidate y points down; model y points up

evidence.description: Area label '1 H+K+S 39.5 M2' read from the source image, divided by the pixel area between the inner faces of the four predicted outer walls.
evidence.derived_by: Claude (AI assistant) read the area label from the source image; the bridge computed the pixel area from predicted wall candidates
evidence.uncertainty_note: Not a measurement. It assumes the label gives the area between the inner faces of the four outer walls, including internal partitions. If the label excludes partitions or the sauna, lengths change by a few percent. Wall faces come from a thresholded mask and are uncertain by about one pixel.

scale.note: NO documented scale evidence exists for this drawing: it has no dimension string and no scale bar. The value is an estimate from the apartment area label, used only so the preview has a plausible size. Metric export of real geometry is BLOCKED until a human supplies or confirms a scale.

coordinate_system.x_axis: source image +x (to the right of the drawing)
coordinate_system.y_axis: source image -y (towards the top of the drawing)
coordinate_system.origin: bottom-left corner of the region of interest, in letterbox space

elevation.basis: Storey elevation from configuration profile 'preview_vertical_defaults_v0'. A plan drawing carries no vertical information; this is an assumption, not a measurement.

ifc.schema_basis: Prototype choice. No receiving BIM application or accepted IFC schema is documented in the inspected repositories.
